## About
Bill's Truck Repair is independently owned and operated. We are a certified Volvo Truck Repair Facility and a Factory Authorized Parts, Service and Warranty Dealer for Volvo Trucks North America.
All our technicians are factory trained. We do complete vehicle repair except body work, from Volvo and Cummins engine electronics to Autoshift transmissions, air conditioning, inspections and fleet maintenance.
We won't let your truck sit. It gets diagnosed and you get a call. Google reviewers rate us 4.3 from 27 reviews.

## Services
- Volvo and Cummins engine electronic diagnostics and repair: Electronic diagnostics and repair on Volvo and Cummins engines.
- Autoshift transmission electronic diagnostics and repair: Electronic diagnostics and repair on Autoshift transmissions.
- Complete vehicle repair (except body work): Everything on the truck but body work.
- Air Conditioning: Truck air conditioning work.
- DOT and BIT inspections: DOT and BIT inspections done in the shop.
- Fleet Maintenance: Maintenance for fleets of trucks.
- All Makes Heavy Duty & Medium Duty Truck Service and Repair: Not just Volvo. We work on all makes.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Do you only work on Volvo trucks?
A: No. We service and repair all makes of heavy duty and medium duty trucks.

Q: Do you do body work?
A: No. We do complete vehicle repair, except body work.

Q: What's the best way in with a trailer?
A: One reviewer suggests coming south bound on Irwindale Ave and turning left into the lot. The right turn is tight.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait?
A: Yes. One reviewer mentioned the lobby, water, a restroom, and that we're pet friendly.
